title: Band nicknames: Posey, Sweetie, Dumpy and Cutie
summary: Freddie Jenkins was called Posey for posing, Lawrence Brown Sweetie for powdering his face, and Duke Dumpy and Cutie; Woodyard still calls him Piano Red.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: How about some of the band nicknames? Where did they come from? Like Ben, Frog; and Johnny, Rabbit; and --
And Posey
-- Posey, Freddie Jenkins.
Freddie Jenkins.
Were you there when they got the nicknames?
No, no, I wasn't.
Do you know -- ?
I was there when they got Posey.
Where did that come from?
I don't know. Oh, he was always showing off, you know, and --
Posing?
-- posing and they called him Posey.
And I think, I heard that Lawrence
Brown was called "Sweetie"?
Sweetie.
Why was that?
Because he was always powdering his face and looking cute, you know. They used to call him -- Joe used to give him the devil and call him Sweetie.
They called Duke "Cutie" at one point, didn't they?
Yeah, they called him "Dumpy," "Cutie." They called him -- what was it? -- another name they used to call him. Oh, --
Sam Woodyard still calls him "Piano Red."
